title: Opening: Betriebsform activates
event: In the central Kaufhaus atrium a building-wide Betriebsform shift runs like a machine: mezzanine panels slide, modular display islands rotate and fold into uniform service counters, and a narrow conveyor unspools across the floor forming a single one-way circulation lane. Pneumatic locks click; plexiglass screens rise from flat cases. The reconfiguration happens as a visible, mechanical choreography across the architecture.
consequence: A new single-file channel of raised plexiglass counters runs down the center of the atrium.
stillPrompt: Wide-angle still of the Kaufhaus central atrium as a practical film set: mezzanine panels mid-slide, modular display islands rotated into neat service counters, an unspooled conveyor strip forming a single one-way lane. Polished tile reflections, cool fluorescent and daylight mixed lighting, visible mechanical hinges and raised plexiglass screens. Empty of people, no signage or readable text, no creature.
videoPrompt: 5s slow crane-in showing the same atrium sequence: panels sliding into place, display islands rotating and locking into counters, conveyor unspooling and tautening. Subtle dust motes, mechanical clicks audible. Keep all motion mechanical and contained to fixtures; do not introduce any creature.
cameraCue: After the panels finish, crane tilts down and dollies forward along the new single-file channel to reveal its length.

title: Fleisch materializes on the counters
event: The reconfigured service counters register the collision with 'Fleisch': refrigerated glass cases pulse and fold open to reveal raw, flesh-like slabs where packaged goods had been. The slabs glisten under display lights; thin streams of pinkish fluid bead and drip onto the polished floor. Refrigeration hums spike as seals re-form around the new organic matter.
consequence: A shallow pool of pinkish liquid and a row of uncovered flesh-like slabs along the counters.
stillPrompt: Close still of a refrigerated display case in the Kaufhaus: inside, raw flesh-like slabs lie on metal racks, wet with beading fluid. Practical textures emphasized — matte fat, sinew-like striations, droplets on glass and a shallow pinkish pool on the tiled floor. Harsh cold-blue case light mixed with warmer ambient overhead. No people, no text, no creature.
videoPrompt: 2s cut-in of the display: glass doors pulse open, a slab trembles and a drop falls into the pooling liquid on the floor, small ripples and condensation trails form on the glass. Keep the motion tactile and confined to the objects.
cameraCue: Low-angle close-up on the dripping slab, then a quick pullback along the row to show multiple cases.

title: H- und P-Sätze seal things around the statue
event: Transparent hazard membranes snap into being and sheath each flesh slab with a tactile hiss. The membranes bead, draw tight, and leave small adhesive seams on the floor. A weathered practical sculpture (the Kaufhaus monster — a physical, aged studio prop) stands already on the atrium tile; membranes cling briefly to its base and stack sealed pouches around its feet like ritual packaging. Small warning-like glass beads form on seams and roll away into grout lines.
consequence: A ring of membrane-sealed pouches stacked at the base of the weathered sculpture; adhesive seams and tiny glass beads scattered on the tiles.
stillPrompt: Location reanchor still: place the canonical practical sculpture monster at the Kaufhaus atrium center surrounded by dozens of transparent membrane-sealed meat pouches. The monster is a weathered studio prop — scratched patina, fabric and concrete textures — lit as a filmed object by mixed cool overhead and warm fill. Close environmental detail: adhesive seams on pouches, small glass-like beads on tiles, no legible text or logos. Use the monster's canonical reference as the physical prop to be photographed in-scene.
videoPrompt: 3s clip starting with the same frame: membranes tighten with audible hisses, tiny beads roll from seams into tile grout and shimmer; sealed pouches are stacked around the sculpture's base. The sculpture remains a static practical object in frame; animate only the membranes, beads, and small ambient reflections. Do not animate the monster entering or appearing.
cameraCue: Midshot at chest height framing the sculpture and surrounding sealed pouches; hold as membranes tighten, then a slight pull back to show the ring of pouches.

title: The Public stacks and spills
event: A small group of shoppers in muted coats arrives and begins to move with machine-like procedure: synchronized hands stack the membrane-sealed pouches onto a service cart in a choreographed loop. Their motion is precise and bureaucratic, like a public ritual. At the end of the routine the overloaded cart tips; pouches tumble across the tiles in a neat, spreading path toward the atrium center.
consequence: A spill of sealed pouches forming a path across the floor toward the central sculpture.
stillPrompt: Mid-shot still focused on hands and torsos in muted coats stacking transparent membrane-sealed pouches into a metal service cart in the Kaufhaus aisle. Motion implied by slight blur, practical lighting, no signage, no creature visible. Emphasize synchronized, procedural movement.
videoPrompt: 2s handheld clip: synchronized stacking, the cart overbalances and tips, sealed pouches tumble and roll in a tidy cascade across polished tiles forming a path toward the atrium center. Keep people non-graphic and procedural.
cameraCue: Quick low-angle dolly to follow the tumbling pouches as they roll toward the center of the atrium.

title: Rupture: panic, dust, the statue holds
event: A sudden rupture: a stacked pallet collides with the spilled pouches, driving a sealed foam canister to burst with a deafening pop and a dense cloud of fine dust that stings lights and sets off alarms. Shoppers scatter in panic, emergency strobes flicker, and a handheld loudspeaker falls and spins on the floor. The weathered sculpture stands in the atrium already at frame start — dust coats its patina; a shard of broken plexiglass embeds against its base from the collision. The scene is chaotic but non-graphic.
consequence: A gray dust plume settles into a long smear across the tiled floor and a piece of shattered plexiglass rests lodged at the statue's base.

No readable text or logos. Use canonical reference image for the monster prop.
videoPrompt: 5s handheld WAN: start on the existing frame (statue present). Animate the foam canister bursting into a dense expanding dust cloud, emergency strobes pulsing, shoppers scattering off-camera, pouches rolling, and the loudspeaker spinning. Keep the sculpture static and filmic; do not animate any entrance or emergence of the monster.
cameraCue: Frantic handheld push through scattering shoppers, then whip-pan to come to rest tight on the monster's dust-coated face.

title: Consumption repurposes the ruin
event: Staff in plain work aprons rapidly repurpose the visible residue into saleable stock. They zip sealed pouches into rigid clear boxes, affix small neutral hang-tags (unreadable) and fasten the boxes to hooks and ledges on the weathered sculpture, transforming it into a literal merchandising plinth. Concession lights warm; a conveyor restarts and a single checkout light blinks. The chaotic residue becomes inventory.
consequence: The weathered sculpture is now a display plinth hung with packaged items; a restarted conveyor and a single lit checkout lane reintroduce commerce into the scene.
stillPrompt: Drift-corrected still of the Kaufhaus atrium: the canonical weathered practical sculpture monster repurposed as a retail plinth, dozens of clear boxed packages fastened to its form, warm concession lighting, a restarted conveyor and a single checkout lane lit. Hands in plain aprons are mid-action attaching a last box. Emphasize practical materials, scratched patina on the prop, and tactile fastenings. No readable text or logos.

cameraCue: Tight over-the-shoulder on the final hand fastening the last box, then a snap-wide to reveal the sculpture now functioning as a display plinth.
